parts.target: A **THOUSAND SONS PSYKER** unit of yours in range of an [objective](vsdata:core-rule/objectives) that you control.
parts.effect: That objective becomes mutated, and stays under your control until a phase ends with your opponent holding a higher [Level of Control](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control) over it than you. While it is mutated and you control it, whenever an enemy unit finishes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)**, **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** or **[charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** in range of it, roll a D6: that enemy unit takes D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) on a 4+.

data.summary:
**When:** [Your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase).

**Target:** A **THOUSAND SONS PSYKER** unit of yours in range of an [objective](vsdata:core-rule/objectives) that you control.

**Effect:** That objective becomes mutated, and stays under your control until a phase ends with your opponent holding a higher [Level of Control](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control) over it than you. While it is mutated and you control it, whenever an enemy unit finishes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)**, **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** or **[charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** in range of it, roll a D6: that enemy unit takes D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) on a 4+.
